messages:
maya: quick thread / PR for tweaking dark theme legend + chart label contrast. spotted a few issues during QA: tiny legend text, overlapping badges on smallcards, and code block colors too close.

jordi: saw that too. on tiny screens the legend hits the KPI title. we should reduce padding and increase contrast rather than shrink text.

sam: color notes: current legend uses #9fb0b6 on --panel. contrast ~4.0:1. aim for >=4.5:1. propose #dbe9ef for legend text and keep muted for secondary meta.

rachel: syntax highlight suggestion: keywords #c6a0ff, strings #ffbf8a, numbers #b2f0d7. also add subtle rounded bg for inline code: rgba(255,255,255,0.04).

maya: small CSS snippet I'll try:

```css
.chart-legend { color: var(--legend-text); padding: 6px 8px; }
.kpi-title { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary); }
```

jordi: accessibility: keyboard focus on legend items doesn't show state properly. focus-visible should be 3px solid of accent with 12% glow.

sam: for charts I'd like to adopt a WCAG-friendly categorical set: #8dd3c7, #bebada, #fb8072, #80b1d3, #fdb462 — works well on dark panels and CVD sims.

rachel: copy nit: in settings change "Enable dark mode" -> "Dark theme" (short + consistent). add tooltip: "Contrast-optimized for nighttime and low-glare work"

design-bot: PR #689 visual-diff: 3 images flagged. CI artifacts -> https://ci.internal/reports/689

maya: I'll update PR with: legend token -> --legend-text: #dbe9ef, bump kpi-title to 14px semibold, focus ring bump, adopt suggested palette, and update inline-code bg. will ping for final sign-off.

jordi: looks good, thanks. small follow-up after merge: add a unit test for legend overlap on <360px widths.

sam: i'll run the colorblind sims once merged. ping me @sam for attachments. :mag:

maya: thanks all, merging after CI green :thumbsup:
